_comment: A cooldown self-buff: for 180 ticks (6 s) every hit the caster lands heals back a fraction of the damage dealt, 30 percent plus 5 per level, working with whichever aura is active. Duration is fixed; leveling raises the leech fraction, not the uptime. All values placeholder.
name: Bloodthirst
description: Works with whichever aura you have on.
